scope: Length-normalized punctuation and exact paired sequence identity diagnostics for Experiment2
timing: Before the main intervention run; six immutable smoke outputs exist and are retained. No condition-labelled readability review has occurred.
definition: For each response, punctuation or other-unusual-punctuation count divided by max(content-token count,1), multiplied by100; report alongside counts, length, empty-output and EOS outcomes.
caution: Length normalization does not make a punctuation token intrinsically malformed. Readability must be judged separately.
